name: Jiao Yi You Xi Li Ta Xian Chen Lun
overview: Meng Jiu Yi disguised herself as a club waitress to secretly film Tan Yu Chen for money. After being exposed and escaping, she fell into his trap again. Jiu Yi is the unloved illegitimate daughter of the Meng family, while Yu Chen is the unruly heir of a wealthy family. Though they appear to have no connection in public, a secret entanglement quietly begins between them.
